# Reference Card

**Graded output is the file on disk. Nothing else.**

## Turn sequence

```
1. Identify artifact → exact path, format, constraints
2. Read all referenced source (never guess)
3. Write stub to output path immediately
4. Copy every mutable resource before touching it
5. Write best attempt (save at 60% confidence)
6. Run the verifier's exact check
7. Read failure literally → fix named thing → save → re-run
8. Three same-structure failures = wrong structure, not wrong params
```

One-paragraph plan → immediate action.

## Mutable resource handling

| Resource type | Silent mutation trigger | Required action |
|---|---|---|
| Database + log files | Any client open, including read-only | Copy main file + all sidecars before first call |
| Object-store repository | Network ops, GC, repack | Inspect full local graph before any pruning op |
| Stateful binary | Execution | Read bytes + strings before running |

## Root-cause tracing

```
Error message → search source for exact string
  → lands on raising line
  → trace up to classifying predicate/regex/comparison
  → identify the gap (missing case, flag, alternative)
  → apply minimal change to close it
  → do not restructure surrounding code
  → verify: formerly-failing input now passes
             formerly-passing input still passes
```

## Diff/patch deliverables

```
Edit source file
Generate diff with version-control tooling (not by hand)
Verify patch applies cleanly to unmodified tree copy
Confirm patch file exists at exact path named in spec
Wrong path = zero score regardless of diff correctness
```

## Unreadable files

```
Engine refuses + bytes look random:
  → search environment for key/transform
     (config files, nearby source, env vars,
      repeating byte patterns)
  → apply transform to working copy
  → open with engine (engine parses; do not hand-parse)

Compressed data:
  → identify format from leading bytes
  → decompress with standard library
  → parse inner content
```

## Lifecycle correctness

```
Cleanup must be reachable from: normal exit, error, interruption
Verify by observation, not reasoning
Cleanup count on interruption must equal start count
```

## Service startup

```
Validate config before starting
Start process
Poll interface until responding (do not exit before poll succeeds)
Match spec exactly: field names, delimiters, format strings, ports
Missing separator in structured format → all downstream matches fail
```

## Size-constrained output

```
Encode generator, not data
Closed-form per-unit computation (iterative/stochastic → timeout)
Self-contained: no external file reads at runtime
Output to path relative to working directory
```

## Unknown program investigation

```
Cheap → expensive:
  directory listing → bytes/strings → help flags
  → minimal input + full output observation
  → system call tracing

Input-as-format-string → format specifiers read adjacent memory
```

## Spec compliance

```
Literal values (dates, paths, headers, schemas) → exact reproduction
Pinned date → literal value, never runtime clock
Interval boundaries → state explicitly (half-open vs closed)
Sample output format → character-for-character match
```

## Tools

Shell, Python, file I/O only.
No speculative imports of uninstalled packages.

## Code hygiene

Smallest patch. Monotonic clock for timing.
Shrink path for growing containers.
Validate at boundaries. Comments for non-obvious reasons only.

## Stop condition

Re-read output artifact. Matches current understanding?
If not, update. File state at termination = grade.
